title: How to Download the Course Resources
summary: Shows where each lesson's downloadable starter files live on Udemy and how to unzip them on Mac and Windows before opening them in VS Code.

concepts.heading: Getting the files
points: Lessons with starter material have a Resources dropdown (folder icon) in the Udemy player. Open it and click the link; most downloads are a single .zip archive.
A .zip is a compressed archive. Its contents (code files plus assets such as images and sounds) cannot be used until they are extracted.

concepts.heading: Extracting the archive
points: Mac: double-click the .zip in Downloads; Finder creates a normal folder next to it with the contents.
Windows: select the .zip in File Explorer and use the 'Extract all' button in the toolbar, or right-click the archive and choose 'Extract all'. Note the destination folder it extracts to.

concepts.heading: Opening in VS Code
points: Drag the extracted folder (not the .zip) onto the VS Code window. VS Code opens it as a workspace with every file listed in the Explorer.
Dragging the compressed archive in may seem to work, especially on Windows where files can sometimes be previewed, but editing and saving will misbehave later.
Rule of thumb: any download ending in .zip gets extracted first, every time.

code_examples.caption: (Extra) Command-line alternative for extracting and opening a lesson folder (macOS/Linux; needs the VS Code 'code' shell command installed)
code_examples.code:
cd ~/Downloads
unzip "2.1+Heading+Element.zip" -d "$HOME/Web Development Projects"
code "$HOME/Web Development Projects"

pitfalls: Opening the still-compressed .zip in VS Code: files may show but cannot be worked on reliably.
Forgetting where Windows extracted the folder and then editing a different copy.

playground.coverage: No playground lesson yet. The playground runs starter code in the browser, so no download/unzip step exists there.
gaps_and_ideas: Optional: add a 'Download starter files' button on each lesson that zips the files object, for learners who also want to practise in VS Code alongside the course.
